name: Under the Umbrella's Shade
description:
The poets have it that spores, like trees, are connected to each other, and that all fungal beings in the world share a single dream. At the end of that dream, the spores would take on the forms of all things, and that all things would return to the beginning — return to being one — and that there would never again be boundaries.
But the evolution of Fungi into sentient, locomotive beings was not something that happened in such primordial times. Regardless, this place has become fertile soil for Fungi to thrive.

tabs.name: The Universal Fungus
tabs.description:
It is said that this was once a natural testing ground for experiments regarding the adaptability and evolutionary capabilities of spores. Whether this is true or not, it is inarguable that this place's Ley Lines make it a real hotbed of fungal evolution.
Someone must cut this evolutionary pathway off before these Fungi can continue spreading and begin to endanger the forest and even the world beyond.
